product_metadata.title: LOKTAR Black Paper Towel Holder, Very High Bond Self Adhesive or Drilling Paper Towel Rack, Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder Wall Mount for Kitchen, Bathroom, Sink, 13 Inch
features: 【Durable & Lightweight】 LOKTAR Paper Towel Holder is made of space aluminum, a lightweight material which can load things up to 5KG. Each joint of the holder has been reinforced and the surface has been covered by protective coating

【Easy to Install】 The paper towel rack provides two mount options: Stick to the surface by 3M magical sticker if the surface is smooth enough, or you can drill the surface and mount it with our screw sets vertically or horizontally

【Widely Used】 The product can be used in multiple ways. It can hold the paper roll under the cabinet, near the sink, on the kitchen wall or in the bathroom, also you can still hang the plastic wrap/ handcloth/facecloth/kitchen tools on the holder
【Universal Size】 LOKTAR paper towel bar is designed by 13 Inch long, which you can hold almost every size of towel paper roll
【After selling Service】 100% moneyback in one month if any broken/problem, 100% get replaced in 12 month if unsatisfied, 100% reply in 24 hours if any questions
